issue.title: Monitor agent-scan never carries tool_run_id: sase-core scan wire lacks monitor_tool_run_id, so monitor list/show and ACE lose the owned ToolRun
issue.description:
Found while researching `sase tool` TUI integration (research:202609/sase_tool_tui_integration_ux__cld.md).

Every monitor read through the agent-scan path reports `tool_run_id: null`, although monitor start
reserves a ToolRun and records it. On athena, `sase monitor list -a -j` has 1,599 rows and 0 with
`tool_run_id`, while the ledger recorded 223 monitor-owned runs in the last 7 days.
`sase monitor show srnrtrezmx4p` (command `sase tool run check`, owner of ToolRun
`04349ecf5cd448d68bc1f9eacfc4488e`) prints no "Tool run" row.

Root cause (verified in both repos):
- sase `src/sase/monitor/start.py:411` writes `monitor_tool_run_id` into the monitor's agent_meta.json.
- sase `src/sase/core/agent_scan_wire_agent_session_turn.py:52,167` has a `tool_run_id` slot mapped
  from `monitor_tool_run_id`, and `src/sase/monitor/models.py:298-300` reads it from the scan result.
- sase-core `crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/wire.rs` (`AgentSessionTurnMonitorWire`, ~line 857) has no
  `tool_run_id` field, and `crates/sase_core/src/agent_scan/scanner.rs:1526-1540` builds the monitor
  wire without reading `monitor_tool_run_id`. The key was added only on the Python side by
  sase-17p.3 (7f450e0112), so it has never round-tripped.

Fix: add `tool_run_id: Option<String>` to the Rust monitor wire and scanner projection (plus
parity tests), move sase's `sase-core-revision.txt` pin, and cover it with a sase test that scans
a monitor with `monitor_tool_run_id` in meta. The ACE TUI side
(`ace/tui/models/_loaders/_meta_enrichment_monitor.py` has no parameter for it) is a separate
consumer and can follow.

task_type_fields.impact: Monitor-owned ToolRuns (223 in 7 days) are unreachable from monitor list/show JSON and human output, and no TUI surface can show a monitor's run, stages, or verdict.
task_type_fields.repro: sase monitor list -a -j | count rows with tool_run_id (0 of 1599 on athena); sase monitor show srnrtrezmx4p shows no Tool run row though agent_meta.json has monitor_tool_run_id=04349ecf5cd448d68bc1f9eacfc4488e

issue.creation_reason: Found during sase tool TUI research: the monitor-to-ToolRun link is lost on every scan-path read, which hides monitor-owned runs from sase monitor show and blocks any TUI surface for them.

payload.description: sase-17p.3 added monitor_tool_run_id on the Python side only; the Rust scan projection was never extended
A ToolRun-opening notification/TUI surface needs the monitor-to-run link this bug drops
